title: NeonNet CyberDeck
subtitle: End-to-End Encrypted Messenger
description: Zero-knowledge encrypted messaging system with RSA-4096/AES-256-GCM hybrid encryption, TCP relay server, and a curses-based TUI interface.
problem: Secure communication requires end-to-end encryption where the server never sees plaintext. Need proper cryptographic primitives — not just encryption as a feature, but as the foundation.
approach: Implemented hybrid encryption (RSA-4096 OAEP for key exchange, AES-256-GCM for messages) with RSA-PSS digital signatures. Built a TCP relay server using Python AsyncIO that forwards only ciphertext.
results: Functional encrypted messenger with key exchange, real-time messaging, file transfer (25MB limit), digital signatures, and a curses-based TUI (CyberDeck). Server operates with zero knowledge of plaintext.
